context: Minthara is a drow Nightwarden who can travel as a companion and be spoken to any time she’s in your party; her replies may shift based on choices you make after she joins, and she will stay loyal and bloodthirsty if you don’t betray her. The excerpts recount her greatest failure at Moonrise Towers: she led a retinue from House Baenre, was won over by General Ketheric Thorm’s flattery, and was betrayed when Orin the Red slaughtered her men. Minthara was taken captive, forced to watch her soldiers being processed, and had a tadpole implanted in her eye—traumas she remembers with anger, shame, and a hunger for revenge. Off‑screen events mentioned in the cluster (for example, a disturbed windmill or the presence of the Moonlantern pixie) may influence who’s around or the tone of conversation but are not shown in these lines.
